discussion_candidates.question: 公共字典更新后，历史商品和单据是否跟随更新？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 公共实体 ID 稳定；历史单据保存展示快照，企业覆盖记录显式 public_id/base_version，改名通过别名或修订处理。
discussion_candidates.resolution: 历史保留原定义，新建时使用最新公共定义。稳定 ID、版本、快照机制仍是待制定的实现方案。

discussion_candidates.question: 企业自己新增的同名车型/核心品名是否优先显示？企业补充通过平台审核后，是否允许升级为公共项？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 企业补充仅本企业可见；同名匹配是合并候选，不直接合并 ID。升级公共项需要显式审阅和别名映射，不改变既有业务引用。

discussion_candidates.question: 库存编号要求在同企业内唯一，还是不同客户也必须全平台唯一？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 企业内业务编号唯一通常足够，内部主键保留平台全局唯一；不要因公共核心品名而共享企业库存序列。

discussion_candidates.question: 同企业普通员工默认可见全部店铺，还是仅分配店铺？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 企业隔离先作为硬边界；库存采购仍按已确认企业共享，店铺可见性另设授权维度，不能用库存共享推断财务/店铺密钥共享。
discussion_candidates.resolution: 默认可见本企业全部店铺；具体操作按岗位权限，敏感字段权限仍另行讨论。

discussion_candidates.question: 平台维护人员协助客户排障时，是否默认只看脱敏运维，读取客户业务需客户授权并记时限？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 平台配置管理与客户业务读取分开；支持访问采用原因、企业、时限、只读范围和审计的显式授权。

discussion_candidates.question: 可从 Ozon 重拉的订单字段允许覆盖哪些值、回溯多久？人工备注、采购/库存关联、利润锁定及历史状态应分别保留。
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 按字段来源设 authority/upstream_updated_at/manual_override，而非整行“用最新覆盖”；只在确认店铺与企业后的隔离缓存重建。

discussion_candidates.question: 历史异常是否采用“有问题的单据禁止自动扣回库/财务写入，其他正常单据继续使用；逐条待核对”的处理方式？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 阻断受影响的写入链；查询标注证据不足，其他企业/订单继续；不为消除告警自动补齐身份或强行核平。

discussion_candidates.question: 员工知识库、旧水印/品牌素材是否准备开放给所有客户，还是目前只是本公司内部资料？
discussion_candidates.recommendation: 未审阅内容和素材来源之前放入平台私有管理域；需要公开时发布经过审阅的公共副本。

discussion_candidates.question: What should happen to existing stock, purchasing, finance history and OGL batches if a shop leaves one enterprise or is transferred?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: History retains its original enterprise; new ownership affects new operations only. No automatic reparenting of stock or accounting facts.

discussion_candidates.question: May employees see every shop in their enterprise, or only assigned shops, while still using the shared enterprise inventory pool?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Keep enterprise as the hard boundary; define optional shop visibility as a narrower permission, separate from inventory ownership.
discussion_candidates.resolution: Employees default to visibility across all shops of their own enterprise; business actions remain role-authorized. Sensitive field policy is a separate open discussion.

discussion_candidates.question: If a current SKU is rebound from one inventory item to another, should old deductions, receipts and settled profit retain the original product?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Keep historical execution facts and frozen costs; new mapping affects future fulfillment. Use an explicit correction event when history is demonstrably wrong.

discussion_candidates.question: Can one supplier purchase or receipt cover orders from multiple shops of the same enterprise, and may unused receipts become common stock?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Yes, consistent with the confirmed shared enterprise inventory/purchasing model; preserve exact quantity allocation and do not cross enterprise.

discussion_candidates.question: When old order identity conflicts with ledger or shipment evidence, should the affected operation pause or allow a documented manual exception?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Preserve raw evidence and mark the affected relationship pending review; block only the ambiguous inventory/accounting write while other enterprise workflows continue.

discussion_candidates.question: How should global dictionary values and enterprise private additions interact when names overlap or the platform updates a value?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Give explicit public/private scope and stable IDs; private additions stay enterprise-only. Confirm override, approval and deprecation behavior before changing schema.
discussion_candidates.resolution: Historical definitions remain unchanged; new records use the latest public definitions. Same-name supplement precedence, approval and deprecation remain open.

discussion_candidates.question: What retention and correction rules apply to financially closed orders, cancellation returns and historical stock balances?
discussion_candidates.proposed_safe_default: Corrections append reversible evidence with actor/reason/before-after values. Avoid recalculating or overwriting locked facts from the latest Ozon state alone.

discussion_candidates: Confirmed target: employees default to visibility across all shops of their own enterprise; inventory/procurement are shared within that enterprise and strictly isolated across enterprises. Action permissions and sensitive field policies remain separate.

AI templates/case examples: decide platform-prepared public examples versus enterprise-created private reusable examples; if sharing is wanted, explicit sanitized publish/copy/version workflow is safer than exposing existing drafts, source images and costs.
Private messaging: decide retention and what happens after a member leaves; reading an old message should not automatically grant access to its referenced order/procurement document.
External shop/company identity: agree on one reviewed binding between official company/store ID and local shop ID before seller-analytics histories are rebound.

Historical exceptions: classify irrecoverable human facts, recoverable platform projections and ambiguous mixed links; preserve unknown as unknown, avoid guessing another order/inventory product by closest title/time.

Acceptable recovery: repull current external state into owned projections without overwriting manual bindings/receipts/profit locks; compare a candidate result and discuss genuine business conflicts before a scoped apply.
